13292-the-romantic.title: The Romantic
13292-the-romantic.creator: Unknown
13292-the-romantic.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. She could see him tiptoeing down her staircase, furtive, afraid. Always afraid they would be found out. That would have ruined him. Oh well--why should he have ruined himself for her? But she had wanted, wanted to ruin herself for him, to stand, superb and reckless, facing the world with him. If that could have been the way of it. That road over the hill--under the yellow painted canopy sticking out from the goods station--it would be the Cirencester road, the Fosse Way.

30530-skipper-worse.title: Skipper Worse
30530-skipper-worse.creator: D. Appleton And Company
30530-skipper-worse.description: A book by D. Appleton And Company. Kielland's method is realistic, and a number of his works are written with a fairly distinct "purpose." As this purpose often involves sharp criticism of conventions and beliefs dear to the comfortable classes, Kielland roused no small amount of opposition and disapproval.

arxiv-1904-03332.title: A tree distinguishing polynomial Thanks: Keywords: Graph polynomial, Trees, Isomorphism invariant. Thanks: Department of Mathematics, Simon Fraser University. Burnaby, BC V5A 1S6, Canada. Thanks: E-mail: pengyu_liu@sfu.ca
arxiv-1904-03332.creator: Pengyu Liu
arxiv-1904-03332.description: Abstract . We define a bivariate polynomial for unlabeled rooted trees and show that the polynomial of an unlabeled rooted tree T T is the generating function of a class of subtrees of T T . We prove that the polynomial is a complete isomorphism invariant for unlabeled rooted trees.

arxiv-2101-04566.title: Frequency Limited ℋ 2 \mathcal{H}_{2} Optimal Model Reduction of Large-Scale Sparse Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2101-04566.creator: Xin Du, M. Monir Uddin, A. Mostakim Fony, Md. Tanzim Hossain, Mohammaed Sahadat-Hossain
arxiv-2101-04566.description: Abstract We mainly consider the frequency limited ℋ 2 \mathcal{H}_{2} optimal model order reduction of large-scale sparse generalized systems. For this purpose we need to solve two Sylvester equations. This paper proposes efficient algorithm to solve them efficiently. The ideas are also generalized to index-1 descriptor systems.

arxiv-2105-01796.title: A GPU-based Kalman Filter for Track Fitting
arxiv-2105-01796.creator: Xiaocong Ai, Georgiana Mania, Heather M. Gray, Michael Kuhn, Nicholas Styles
arxiv-2105-01796.description: Abstract Computing centres, including those used to process High-Energy Physics data and simulations, are increasingly providing significant fractions of their computing resources through hardware architectures other than x86 CPUs, with GPUs being a common alternative. GPUs can provide excellent computational performance at a good price point for tasks that can be suitably parallelized.

arxiv-2112-13966.title: Online Adversarial Knowledge Distillation for Graph Neural Networks Journal: Expert Systems With Applications
arxiv-2112-13966.creator: Can Wang, Zhe Wang, Defang Chen, Sheng Zhou, Yan Feng, Chun Chen
arxiv-2112-13966.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Can Wang, Zhe Wang, Defang Chen, Sheng Zhou, Yan Feng, Chun Chen. Knowledge distillation, a technique recently gaining popularity for enhancing model generalization in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), operates under the assumption that both teacher and student models are trained on identical data distributions. However, its effect on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) is less than satisfactory since the graph topology and node attributes are prone to evolve, thereby leading to the issue of distribution shift.

arxiv-2210-09797.title: Hadronuclear interactions in the jet of low TeV luminosity AGN: Implications for the low-state very-high-energy gamma-ray emission
arxiv-2210-09797.creator: Rui Xue 1, Ze-Rui Wang 2, Wei-Jian Li 1
arxiv-2210-09797.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Rui Xue 1, Ze-Rui Wang 2, Wei-Jian Li 1. In the study of radiation mechanisms of AGNs’ jets, hadronuclear ( p ​ p pp ) interactions are commonly neglected, because the number density of cold protons in the jet is considered insufficient. Very recently, our previous work proves that p ​ p pp interactions in the low TeV luminosity AGNs, which have potential to generate detectable very-high-energy (VHE) emission, could be important.

arxiv-2212-02440.title: New Algorithms for the Fair and Efficient Allocation of Indivisible Chores Thanks: A preliminary version of this paper appeared at IJCAI 2023 [ 20 ] . Work supported by NSF Grant CCF-1942321.
arxiv-2212-02440.creator: Jugal Garg, Aniket Murhekar, John Qin
arxiv-2212-02440.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jugal Garg, Aniket Murhekar, John Qin. We study the problem of fairly and efficiently allocating indivisible chores among agents with additive disutility functions. We consider the widely-used envy-based fairness properties of EF1 and EFX, in conjunction with the efficiency property of fractional Pareto-optimality (fPO). Existence (and computation) of an allocation that is simultaneously EF1/EFX and fPO are challenging open problems, and we make progress on both of them.

pmc-10589391.title: Non-functional Pituitary Adenomas: Analysis of Delayed Diagnosis in Mexico
pmc-10589391.creator: Sergio Moreno Jiménez, Issac Vargas-Olmos, Andrea Ceballos-Arana, Karen A Miranda-Fernández, Dan Morgenstern-Kaplan, Fabiola Flores-Vázquez, Álvaro Bedoya-Gómez, Paula A Contreras-Núñez
pmc-10589391.description: Background: Although tumors of the central nervous system (CNS) are rare, they can cause significant morbidity and mortality. The clinical presentation of patients with non-functional pituitary adenomas (NFPA) ranges from being completely asymptomatic to causing pituitary, hypothalamic, or visual dysfunction due to their large size. Patients usually arrive with large tumors at the time of diagnosis.

pmc-11620237.title: Multi-strategy improved runge kutta optimizer and its promise to estimate the model parameters of solar photovoltaic modules
pmc-11620237.creator: Serdar Ekinci, Rizk M Rizk-Allah, Davut Izci, Emre Çelik
pmc-11620237.description: Harnessing the potential of solar photovoltaic (PV) technology relies heavily on accurately estimating the model parameters of PV cells/modules using real current-voltage (I-V) data. Achieving optimal parameter values is essential for the performance and efficiency of PV systems, necessitating the use of advanced optimization techniques.

pmc-13379982.creator: Canan Akdeniz, Arzum Güler Doğru
pmc-13379982.description: BackgroundLarge Language Model (LLM) –based chatbots are increasingly used in patient information processes. pmc-13402347.title: Highly sensitive X-ray responsive molecular switches
pmc-13402347.creator: Jiangang Li, Kuanjian Wei, Xiangmei Liu, Zijian Zhou, Peiling Dai, Jiacheng Shen, Xiuwen Xu, Mingye Zhu, Mengzhu Wang, Yuchang Wang, Yongjing Deng, Shujuan Liu, Yun Ma, Qiang Zhao
pmc-13402347.description: X-ray-triggered molecular switching promises remote control behind physical barriers, yet existing radioswitches typically require multi-gray doses to reach a photostationary state. Here we route X-ray energy through triplet excitons to enable low-dose switching. An efficient scintillator acts as a triplet sensitizer, transferring energy to a photoswitch with lower triplet energy via triplet-triplet energy transfer (TTET).

uslaw-usc-t2-s1410.title: 2 U.S.C. § 1410 — Other judicial review prohibited
uslaw-usc-t2-s1410.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s1410.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 24 (Congressional Accountability); Subchapter IV (Administrative And Judicial Dispute-Resolution Procedures). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Except as expressly authorized by sections 1407, 1408, and 1409 of this title, the compliance or noncompliance with the provisions of this chapter and any action taken pursuant to this chapter shall not be subject to judicial review.
